messages:
alex (customer): Hey team, running into OAuth sign-in failures for some users on our iOS app. Getting `invalid_grant: code_verifier mismatch` after GitHub redirects. This started after we rolled out the new CDN.
jamie (support): Sorry to hear that — can you paste the exact redirect URL you're seeing and any server logs? Also how many users impacted?
alex (customer): About ~3% of login attempts. Example redirect: `https://app.example.com/auth/callback?code=abc123&state=eyJw...` but on the client we see the original deeplink had `#/oauth?state=...&code=...` (mobile uses fragment). Server log shows `oauth:error invalid_grant code_verifier mismatch` at time 2026-03-15T14:08:09Z.
mike (eng): Interesting — fragments are client-side only so something in the mobile flow must be moving state into a cookie or query string before redirect. Do you have the network capture from the mobile webview or the Set-Cookie headers from the callback response?
alex (customer): I grabbed the WebView request/response. Relevant headers from the callback response: `Set-Cookie: session_part1=eyJzdGF0ZSI6ImEyY...; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly` and a second header `Set-Cookie: session_part2=0x9f3a...; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly` — looks like the session state got split across two cookies (cookie chunking).
sasha (eng-sre): Cookie split + fragment-based state + CDN rewriting is a red flag. Also note some CDNs strip or normalize trailing slashes and rewrite fragments into query if misconfigured with mobile deep links and proxy rewrites.
jamie (support): @mike @sasha can you confirm if PKCE verifier is being stored in a cookie or in localStorage? The `code_verifier` has to match what the client sent.
mike (eng): We store ephemeral vendor state in a cookie (for mobile webview compatibility). If the cookie got split and only one chunk arrived during the exchange, server-side `code_verifier` would be truncated -> mismatch. Two quick repros: 1) long state + cookie chunking, 2) mobile deep link that encodes state in fragment and our CDN rewrites it into query but mangles encoding.
jamie (support): Can you share minimal repro steps so we can reproduce in-house?
alex (customer): Steps: 1) iOS app opens `https://auth.example.com/start?redirect_uri=myapp://login#%2Foauth%3Fstate%3D<bigstate>` 2) WebView does GitHub auth -> GitHub redirects to `https://app.example.com/auth/callback#code=...&state=<bigstate>` 3) CDN rewrites to `https://app.example.com/auth/callback?code=...&state=<truncated>` 4) Server reads cookie `session` but only gets `session_part1` (cookie limit hit) -> `code_verifier` mismatch -> error.
sasha (eng-sre): I captured edge logs for a similar user: `edge-123 14:07:58 GET /auth/callback?code=abc&state=eyJw...-truncated  302` and `Set-Cookie: session=eyJ2ZXJpZmllcjoiYmFzZTY0...` but `Cookie` header sent back on subsequent POST is only partial. Looks like cookie exceeded 4KB and got chunked; some mobile webviews drop later cookie chunks.
mike (eng): For reproduction locally: use this curl to simulate callback with long cookie chunking: ```bash
curl -v -H "Cookie: session_part1=eyJzdGF0ZSI6ImEiOw; session_part2=0x9f3a..." "https://app.example.com/auth/callback?code=abc&state=<bigstate>"
``` If only session_part1 is present server computes wrong verifier.
jamie (support): Thanks, that's actionable. Alex, I'll escalate to platform infra. For immediate mitigation can you: a) shorten the state to <200 chars OR b) switch mobile deeplink to pass state in query param (percent-encoded) OR c) use localStorage flow for PKCE instead of cookies. Any of those doable short-term? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
alex (customer): Shortening state is quick, we'll try that first. Also curious if we should update CDN config.
sasha (eng-sre): We found a config bug at the CDN edge where it rewrites fragments for `myapp://` deeplinks and mistakenly decodes + re-encodes the state causing truncation for large payloads. We're pushing a staged fix to stop fragment->query rewriting.
mike (eng): Longer term: we should avoid storing PKCE verifier in cookies for mobile flows. Suggestion: 1) store verifier in in-memory/localStorage for the webview 2) keep server cookie only for session (opaque id) 3) add a validation step that rejects chunked cookies early with a clear error message.
jamie (support): Noted. Alex — once you shorten state, please share a failing request if it still happens and we'll attach additional logs. For tracking I've created an internal ticket: INC-2026-451 and pinged infra. :white_check_mark:
alex (customer): Quick update: shortened state -> login success for the few users who were failing. Thanks all. Will wait for CDN config change and longer-term PKCE flow redesign.
sasha (eng-sre): We'll roll the CDN edge fix in the next deploy window and validate with synthetic mobile webview tests. Will post updates here.
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-16T02:00:00Z started for `cdn-edge` -> rollout 10%
mike (eng): Follow-up action items: 1) infra: stop fragment rewriting for deeplinks 2) eng: issue to migrate mobile PKCE storage 3) support: note mitigation guidance in KB.
jamie (support): Adding KB note now: "OAuth mobile deeplink: avoid large state in fragments, prefer query params or client storage; if using cookies ensure cookie size <4KB and test webview cookie chunk handling." :memo:
alex (customer): Thanks team, closing on our side for now.
